User.title: User
User.description: Creative professional or client user profile

id.description: User unique identifier matching auth UID

accountType.description: Type of account: creative artist or hiring client

bio.description: Biographical summary of experience and credentials

skills.description: List of core creative skills or specialties

hourlyRate.description: Stated hourly or day rate range

verified.description: Whether user identity and credentials have been verified

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the profile was created

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of most recent profile update

Quest.title: Quest
Quest.description: High-stakes creative gig opportunity with escrow protection

title.description: Title of the creative gig or position

description.description: Detailed project brief and deliverable specifications

clientName.description: Name of the hiring client or production company

clientUid.description: Auth UID of the client who posted the quest

category.description: Creative category (e.g., Audio, Visual, Direction, Production)

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the quest

escrowProtected.description: Whether payment is locked in verified smart escrow

Application.title: Application
Application.description: Application/proposal submitted by a creative to a quest

applicantUid.description: Auth UID of the applying creative

applicantName.description: Full name of the applying creative

proposalText.description: Proposal message pitch and delivery approach

userId.description: Auth UID of the user saving the quest

/users/{userId}.description: User profile document indexed by Auth UID

/applications/{applicationId}.description: Proposals submitted by creatives for quests
